text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: On the day of Christmas, Io was looking for a present on the main street for {0}, as a token of her gratitude.
text_block_list.orig_text:
クリスマス当日。
イオは日頃のお礼も兼ねて{0}のために
プレゼントを目抜き通りで探していた。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I was looking for a present, but it already got this late. I wonder what kind of things {0}-kun would want...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～ん……
プレゼントを探していたら
こんな時間になっちゃったわ。
結局、
{0}君ってどんな物が欲しいのかしら……？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: If I were to give him a present as his teacher, I'd give a reference book, right? Ah, but recently I've seen him trying his best with the ones he bought recently.
text_block_list.orig_text:
教師としてプレゼントするなら、
やっぱり参考書？
あ、でも
最近自分で買ったのを頑張って読んでたわね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: I'm sure he'll be happy with whatever gift I give him, but that in itself just makes it harder to narrow it down... What should I do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
何をプレゼントしても
きっと喜んでくれると思うけど、
これじゃあ逆に絞り切れなくなっちゃう……
本当にどうしたらいいのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Maybe I shouldn't give a "thing", but perhaps an "experience"...? Maybe from now on, I'll ask him to always have dinner together... but that'd be weird since we're teacher and student...
text_block_list.orig_text:
物じゃなくて、
体験にするとか……？
これから一緒にディナーは……
教師と生徒じゃ変だし……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Perhaps, maybe... I should just give myself as a present to him...? Wait, huh, what am I even thinking? Geez!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もういっそのこと、
私自身をプレゼント……？
って、
私ったら何を考えているのかしらっ。
もうもうっ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, that's right! If it's an experience I want to gift, then I know just the one♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あっ、
そうだ！
体験なら、
一番いいのがあるじゃない♪

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: I wonder if {0} will like it? Hehehe♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
彼、
喜んでくれるかしら？
うふふっ♪

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Surprise present~☆
text_block_list.orig_text: サプライズプレゼント～☆

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Hehe, did I catch you off guard? Surprised?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
びっくりしてくれたかしら？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Tonight, I've come to visit you in your dreams to gift you a special field trip.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今夜はね、
君に特別な社会科見学をさせてあげたくて
夢の中にお邪魔しにきたわ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: {0}-kun has learned a lot and grown up, so I want to show you how everyone works around many worlds so you can think about your future.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君もたくさん学んで成長してきたから、
君が将来のことを考えるために、
みんながどんなふうに働いているのか見せてあげたいの。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Let's start from... here! Yes, it's Grand Dream Park♪ Miss Lyrael taught me all about it. What do you think? Isn't it getting you excited?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずはここよ！　
そう、
グランドリームパーク♪
ライラエルさんに教えてもらったの。
どうかしら？　
わくわくしてこない？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's great to hear♪ Well then, let's go and have some fun and see the staff at work!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
よかった♪
それじゃあ早速、
遊びながら
スタッフさんたちの働く姿を見に行きましょう！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Actually, I... I've always dreamed of going to an amusement park with someone! One of my dreams came true in your dream♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
実は私、
誰かと一緒に遊園地に遊びに行くのが夢だったの！
夢の中で夢が一つ叶っちゃったわ♪

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Aaah, I don't know where to start! Is there any attraction you want to go to, {0}-kun?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ～、
どこから行けばいいのか迷っちゃう！
{0}君は行ってみたいアトラクションはある？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: You have a recommendation? {0}, have you perhaps been here before? ...Huh? You worked here to help a while back?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オススメの？
君、
もしかしてここに来たことがあるの？
……えっ、
前にお手伝いしてた！？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: My, I see! Sounds like a wonderful experience. Well then, I suppose I'll let you lead the way then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
そうだったの！
素敵な体験をしたのね。
それじゃあ、
君にリードをお任せしちゃおうかしら。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Aaah, that was so much fun~♪ It was like I was traveling all over Astrum, I couldn't stop feeling excited and nervous!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
楽しかった～♪
まるでアストルムの各地を旅してるみたいで、
ワクワクとドキドキが止まらなかったわ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Of course I do♪ I was surprised to see dolls of some girls I know, and more than anything, it made me want to go on an adventure myself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろんよ♪
知ってる子のお人形が出てきてびっくりしたし、
何より私も
冒険したいなって憧れちゃった♪

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, aaah?! I'm so sorry, I forgot that this is supposed to be an educational field trip, and I've become completely engrossed in that attraction...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……って、
ああ！？
私ったらごめんなさい、
社会科見学だってことを忘れて、
すっかりアトラクションに夢中になっちゃってたわ……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: As your Sensei, I have to do things properly! Next up, let's go to a place where we can witness a very rare experience!
text_block_list.orig_text:
先生としてちゃんとしないとね！
次は
珍しい体験ができるところに行きましょう！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: As you probably know, the members of the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE train every day to protect us. Today, let's go take a look at how exactly they're training.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちを守るために
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】のみなさんが
日々訓練を重ねているのは、
君も知っての通りだと思うわ。
今日はその様子を
ちょっとだけ見せてもらいましょう♪

text_block_list.name: Royal Knight 1
text_block_list.text: Abs! Back muscles! Push-ups! Run in! Next up is abs, back muscles! Squats! And then run in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
腹筋！　
背筋！　
腕立て伏せ！　
走り込み！
次は腹筋！　
背筋！　
スクワット！　
そして走り込みだ！

text_block_list.name: Royal Knight 2
text_block_list.text: Without basic training, you can’t even protect what you’re protecting! Train hard enough that even if your sword breaks, you can overwhelm your opponent with just your bare hands!
text_block_list.orig_text:
基礎訓練が無ければ
守るものも守れないぞ！
剣が折れても、
身一つで相手を圧倒できるほどに鍛え上げるんだ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Huh? Perhaps you already knew about the training they do here? ...On the contrary, you've helped out in the training organization before? I-Is that really so?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
もしかしてここの訓練を知ってるの？
……それどころか、
前に訓練の手伝いをしていたことがある？
そ、
そうだったの！？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: I thought I could show and teach you things you didn't know by coming here... Hmm, it seems field trips can be quite tough in their own right...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここなら君の知らないことを教えてあげられると思ったのに……
うーん、
社会科見学も結構難しいのね……

text_block_list.name: Royal Knight 1
text_block_list.text: Kh! T-That woman over there... Could she be the new instructor?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
むっ、
あそこにいる女性……
もしや
新しい教官では！？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.orig_text: えっ？

text_block_list.name: Royal Knight 2
text_block_list.text: Instructor, guide us, please, I beg you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
教官、
俺たちを指導してください！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: EEEEHHHH?! I'm not an instructor, but a teacher!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええーっ！？
私は教官じゃなくて、
先生なのに～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Phew, we finally managed to escape... This feels a lot tougher than a normal field trip...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ、
ようやく逃げ切れたわ……
なんだか普通の社会科見学よりも大変な気がするわ……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: I wanted to teach you more things that you didn't know, {0}-kun, but I haven't been able to teach you anything... Am I a bad teacher...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もっと{0}君の知らないことを
たくさん教えたかったのに、
全然教えられてないし……
私って
ダメな先生なのかしら……？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Just like that, you're always so kind to me. But... yeah, it seems I misjudged you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
君はいつも私に優しくしてくれるのね。
でも……
うん、
私が君のことを見誤っていたみたい。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Until now, I had always thought of you as just my student, but before I knew it, you had grown into a fine man.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
今まで君のことを
一人の生徒だとばかり思っていたけど、
君はいつの間にか
立派な人に成長していたのね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Normally, I should be happy to see my students grow... but I wonder why. In the midst of all this happiness, I also feel a little lonely. It's strange.
text_block_list.orig_text:
教え子の成長って普通はうれしいはずなのに……
どうしてかしら。
うれしさの中に、
ちょっとだけ寂しさがあるの。
不思議ね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'm more of a teacher than I thought I was, because I can't let go of my student...
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分で思っていたよりも、
私って
生徒離れできない先生なのかも……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: ...Now that I think about it, there was a scene in a manga I've been into lately where the master was touched by her grown-up disciple. It was just like us right now and then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そういえば、
最近ハマってる漫画でも
成長した弟子に
師匠がキュンときちゃうシーンがあったなあ。
まるで今の私たちみたいで──

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: W-We can't, we can't! We can't do that now! We have a pure teacher-student relationship!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダ、
ダメダメ！
今のなし！　
いけないわ！
私たちは
清い先生と生徒の関係なのよ～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: N-No, it's nothing! Anyway, why don't we try experiencing how an astronomer works for the last visit♪? I've prepared a telescope, so use it to look up at the night sky!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
ううん、
なんでもないの！
それより
最後は天文学者さんのお仕事を体験してみましょうか♪
天体望遠鏡を用意してあるから、
それで夜空を見上げてみて！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: What do you think? Can you see it clearly? When you look up at the sky, the stars that always shine above your head can look different than usual♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
どう？　
よく見えるかしら？
空を見上げればいつも頭上で輝く星が、
いつもと違って見えるわよね♪

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you seem to be completely fascinated. Oh, I know! Let's go take a closer look.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
すっかり夢中みたいね。
そ
うだ、
もっと近くで見てみましょうよ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: This is a dream world after all. When you want to fly, you can fly as far as you want♪ Come on, let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここは夢の世界だもの。
飛びたいと願ったその時には、
どこまでだって飛んで行けるわ♪
ほら、
行きましょう！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Wow, it's so pretty... So this is the view that spreads out in the sky...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
わあ、
きれい……
空の上にはこんな景色が広がっていたのね……♪

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: It's a dream world however, so I'm sure it's just a product of our imagination...
text_block_list.orig_text:
夢の世界だから、
きっと私たちの想像でしかないけれど……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's right. Above all else, what's in front of us right now is more important!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
その通りね。
何よりもまず、
今目の前にあるものの方が大切よね！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Shall we proceed? Let's look forward to what lies ahead... together♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
進みましょうか。
この先にあるものを楽しみに、
二人で♪

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: ...The scenery has changed a lot. Look, the stars look so small. We are probably flying somewhere among those particles of light.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……だいぶ景色が変わってきたわね。
見て、
星たちがあんなに小さく見えるわ。
あの光の粒のどこかで、
私たちは暮らしているのね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Spending time with you, {0}-kun, was so much fun that I couldn't help but get engrossed in it. Hehe, this truly was a dream-y time in all senses♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君との時間が楽しすぎて、
つい夢中になっちゃったみたい。
ふふ、
本当に楽しかった♪

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Well, we've come a long way, so it's time to head home. The Devil Sensei's field trip will last until we both wake up from our dream♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
ずいぶん遠くまで来ちゃったし、
そろそろ帰りましょうか。
夢から覚めるまでが
悪魔のせんせーの社会科見学ですよ♪

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: If you sleep in a dream, you'll be able to return to the real world. Sensei will be sleeping with you, so you'll sleep more easily.
text_block_list.orig_text:
夢の中で眠れば、
現実の世界に戻れるわ。
よく眠れるように
先生が添い寝してあげますからね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Come on, get in this bed made of clouds. If you pull back those curtains made of stars, you'll surely fall asleep in no time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
雲のベッドに入って。
星のカーテンを引けば、
きっとすぐに眠くなるわ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: I hope you'll remember each and every one of the fun things that happened today... Good night.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日あった楽しかったことを
一つ一つ思い出しながら……
おやすみなさい。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: ... Hehe, he's already asleep. I thought he'd grown up, but his sleeping face still looks like a baby's♪ This impression gap is making my heart flutter...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふふ、
もう寝ちゃった。
成長したんだなって思ったけど、
寝顔はまだ赤ちゃんみたい♪
ギャップでまたときめいちゃうかも……♪

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: I no longer have the courage to kiss you like I did back then, but my wish is for you to think this was a good dream...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの時みたいにキスする勇気はもうないけど、
いい夢だったなって思ってもらえるように、
願いを込めて……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: *kiss*...
text_block_list.orig_text: ちゅっ……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Good morning, {0}-kun. Have a great Christmas. Did you sleep well?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おはよう、
{0}君。
クリスマスはお疲れさま。
よく眠れたかしら？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: ...You felt like you've met me in a dream just last night? A-Aren't you just imagining things? I'm sure you are, yes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……夢の中で私と会った気がする？
き、
気のせいじゃないかしらっ？
きっとそうよ、
ええ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: U-U-Uuuumm... I just remembered something I need to do! Well then, make sure to take it easy and stay warm! Have a good year!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
ええっと……
私、
用事を思い出したから！
そ
れじゃあ、
暖かくして過ごすのよ！　
よいお年をー！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: As he watched Io flee, {0} simply tilted his head at her weird reaction.
text_block_list.orig_text:
逃げるように去っていったイオを見送りながら、
{0}はただ首を傾げるのだった。
